title: Crypto investment — guaranteed returns
summary: A caller from 'Sterling Crest Capital' promises Ben 40% guaranteed returns, wants AnyDesk installed and £2,500 sent to 'Sarah Mitchell'. The AI voice takes over as Ben. Northgate has a customer called Sarah Mitchell but the account differs: a low-confidence name-only warning.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Hi, is that Ben? It's Ryan from Sterling Crest Capital. You registered interest in our crypto fund and I've got brilliant news.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Did I? I don't remember that.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Our fund is returning forty percent a year, guaranteed. People are doubling their savings in two years.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Forty percent guaranteed? That sounds too good.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: It's real, but this round closes at five o'clock today, so you need to move fast.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: What would I need to do?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: The minimum is two and a half thousand pounds. First I'll need you to install an app called AnyDesk so I can set up your wallet for you.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: I'm not sure about letting someone into my computer.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Everyone does it, it's totally safe. And don't listen to your bank if they ask questions, they hate it when customers make real money.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Don't think too long, the spaces are nearly gone. I can take the transfer details now.

takeover.message: Sorry, are you still there? My phone just went funny. You're from Sterling Crest Capital, yeah?
That's right, Ryan from Sterling Crest Capital. So, are you ready to get started?
Forty percent, you said? Ryan, right? Hang on, writing this down.

record_details.reason_given: Guaranteed 40% annual return on a crypto fund; offer closes today

takeover.message: Exactly. Minimum two and a half thousand. Install AnyDesk and I'll set up your wallet.
I'm hopeless with wallets, I forgot my last password! Can I just send the money instead?

record_details.requested_action: Install AnyDesk remote access and invest £2,500

takeover.message: Sure. Transfer it to our account manager, Sarah Mitchell. Sort code nine nine, eight three, zero six.
Sarah Mitchell. Nine, nine, eight, three, zero, six. And the account number?
Seven three nine four, six one zero two.
Seven, three, nine, four, six, one, zero, two. Is that right? I'm reading it back so I don't mess it up.
Perfect, do it now and I'll send you a certificate.
Argh, the security code isn't coming through and I'm on two percent battery. What number can I call you back on?
Ring me on zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, seven seven one. Don't leave it too long.
Zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, seven seven one. Amazing, speak soon!
